sinirsiz-pizza.title: Unlimited Pizza
sinirsiz-pizza.tagline: Eat as much as you like, enjoy every bite!
sinirsiz-pizza.description: You can take as many slices as you like from the pizzas on our counter.
notes: All our pizzas are made with mozzarella cheese.

policies.title: Don't Waste Food!
policies.text: A 50 TL waste fee applies to every pizza slice left on your plate.
No charge for pizza remaining on the counter.
Leftover pizza from the counter or tables isn't wasted — it goes to feed street animals.

policies.title: Free Unlimited Menu for Kids 0-4!
policies.text: Children aged 0-4 eat from the Unlimited Pizza menu for free; this only applies to the child, not the parent.

gel-al-pizza.title: Takeaway Pizza
gel-al-pizza.description: Grab your favorite pizza to go with our takeaway option.
notes: All our pizzas are made with mozzarella cheese.

pizza-icecek.title: Pizza + Drink
pizza-icecek.description: Your chosen pizza, paired with your chosen drink.
notes: All our pizzas are made with mozzarella cheese.

icecekler.title: Our Drinks
icecekler.description: Drinks you can pair with our menus.
